source_priority.source: CFFEX official historical Level-1 or Level-2 data product
source_priority.reason: official historical snapshot provenance and best-bid/best-ask capability

source_priority.source: licensed vendor feed with field-level provenance traceable to CFFEX
source_priority.reason: allowed only when source lineage, timestamp semantics and quote fields are documented and checksummed

source_priority.source: daily OHLC, minute OHLC, last-price-only, midpoint-only or scraped delayed snapshots without stable history
source_priority.reason: cannot measure executable spread at the inherited causal entry and exit clocks

canonical_semantics.contract_code: CFFEX MO contract identity, e.g. MOYYMM-C-STRIKE or MOYYMM-P-STRIKE
canonical_semantics.expiry: contract expiry date; must not precede quote timestamp date
canonical_semantics.timestamp: exchange-local quote timestamp normalized to Asia/Shanghai without future interpolation
canonical_semantics.bid1: best bid in index points; zero allowed only when source explicitly encodes no valid bid
canonical_semantics.bid1_size: best bid size in contracts; non-negative
canonical_semantics.ask1: best ask in index points; zero allowed only when source explicitly encodes no valid ask
canonical_semantics.ask1_size: best ask size in contracts; non-negative
canonical_semantics.last_price: diagnostic only; never substitute for bid1/ask1 in the primary mapping
canonical_semantics.volume: source-defined cumulative or interval volume; semantics must be declared in manifest
canonical_semantics.trading_status: raw or normalized exchange/vendor status; mapping must be declared in manifest

data_role_contract.prospective_boundary_rule: must be frozen before any event-conditioned option outcome is inspected

explicit_prohibitions: no option PnL or premium-return study before PASS admission receipt
no favorable year, regime or time-of-day filtering
no midpoint or last-price replacement for executable bid/ask
admission_decision_rule: PASS only when manifest contract, file checksums, canonical schema, timestamp semantics, quote integrity and frozen fee contract all pass. Otherwise FAIL with no empirical option outcomes opened.
